checks.evidence: Images.lean defines image f p y as ∃ x, p x ∧ f x = y and preimage f q x as q (f x); Included is pointwise implication from the imported predicates module.
JL027 has arbitrary α and β, arbitrary f, p and q, and explicit universal y/x and existential preimage witnesses. Empty types are not excluded.
No injectivity, surjectivity, decidability, or selected inverse of f is required. The theorem assumes no instance of either side of its claimed equivalence.
The target expands exactly to image(f,p)⊆q ↔ p⊆preimage(f,q), written using only ∀, ∃, ∧, equality and implication in the named contract.

Forward direction applies the image inclusion to witness x at f x. Reverse direction extracts x from an existing image proof and transports h x hx along f x=y. Image composition and union preservation likewise construct witnesses without choice.
